dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: As you can see, looking out from the watchtower, the seas around Mondstadt are calm and peaceful.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Since those days went by, Lord Barbatos has been protecting Mondstadt. There have been no storms ever since.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Even our family has not seen a true storm for many generations.
